visual_action: A montage of chaotic, destructive, and panicked scenes from the animated TV show SpongeBob SquarePants. Clips include the character SpongeBob surrounded by flames, Mr. Krabs in a boiling pot, Squidward looking battered on a couch, a spiky steamroller, and a wide shot of the cartoon city of Bikini Bottom on fire with its residents fleeing in terror.
